extension.summary: Repository browser, search, and health checker for Kodi
extension.description:
CorpTeam Repo Tools helps you browse installed Kodi repositories, search add-ons, inspect video add-ons, review metadata quality, and check repository health before installing.
[B][COLOR mediumpurple]Update:[/COLOR][/B] • Improved repository health checks • Better video add-on inspection • Added debugger mode for advanced details • Faster repository loading and search • Cleaner interface and Kodi skin compatibility
extension.disclaimer: This add-on only reads repository and add-on metadata from repositories already installed in Kodi. It does not host, stream, scrape, or provide media content.
